tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ gu ru nyid dang dbyer med sgrub pa'i tshul// zab lam yid bzhin nor bu 'di kho nas// 'brel tshad gdod ma'i sa la skyel mdzad pa'i// ngo mtshar gzhan phan rgyal sras 'jug ngogs bri// 'dir rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i rgyal dbang dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi zhi khro nges don snying po la brten nas gnas brgya gsog lugs kyi 'don 'grigs la/ hrī: sngon bskal= gsol 'debs/ bgegs gtor nas siddhi snyen pa yan tshar nas/ zhi khro'i mdun bskyed che ba/ swa bhā ba= nas/ tshar gcod par bsgom: 'og gi lha tshogs de dag= nas/ sa ma ya ho: yan gtang*/ bshags skong mtha'i/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer gzungs thag= sogs nas/ sngags rnams nyis brgya re/ las bum rdor sems/ sa twa stong*/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ hūm̐ hrī: mchod yon= sogs dang*/ hūm̐ hrī: padma 'od 'bar gnas lngar= sogs sho lo ka re re/ dge bsngo bcas/ spyi 'dus gtor bsngo/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bdag nyid= sogs nas/ sdong grogs mdzod: bar dang*/ bshags skong ga ི mdun gyi nam mkhar= sogs nas/ yig brgya brgya/ sa twa stong*/ a a ā: bar dang*/ spyi 'dus tshogs/ hrī: bdag nyid lha yi= sogs nas/ pū dza khā hi: bar dang*/ bshags skong gi hūm̐: stong gsum= nas/ don dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: bar dang*/ 316) spyi 'dus gnam phud/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma rgya mtsho= nas/ u tstshiṣṭa ba ling ta khā hi: bar dang*/ bshags skong gi hūm̐: dngos po chos nyid= nas/ a a: tshogs 'khor phul ba'i= sogs/ rig pa me dor ba ni/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya oṃ: ā badzra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: swa badzra sa ma ya swa: hā badzra sa ma ya hā: oṃ: ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las rmad po che: de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas: phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig: oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: oṃ badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ: oṃ badzra sa ma ya ho: slob ma 'jug pa'i gsal gdab ni/

oṃ: rdo rje'i ye shes thob byed pa'i: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: bdag gi slob ma 'jug par 'tshal: zhes brjod/ gshin po rjes 'dzin la/ oṃ badzra satwa= nas/ 'gugs pa lan gsum/ sarba bignan= lan gsum/ sum bhā= ni lan gsum rnams gzhung gsal rgyas par byas nas/ gnyis med du thim par bsgom/ spyi 'dus/ hrī: sngon gyi= dang*/ zhi khro'i/ hūm̐: rang bzhin chos kyi= sogs/ tshig bzhi/ siddhi/ bho dhi/ ru lu/ badzra= sogs nas/ lte bar thim par bsgom/ brjod med shes rab kyi bkra shis/ 217) gtso bor ji ltar= sa gzhi/ deng nas brtsams te= 'di nas shar gyi= nas/ byed nus par gyur cig: smon lam ji rigs bcas bya'o// de nas bsdus pa'i lugs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams thams cad= sogs tshig rkang dgu dang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang gi gnas gsum= nas/ gsal bar bskyed: zhi khro'i mdun bskyed bsdus pa/ swa bhā ba= stong pa'i ngang las rgyal ba= sogs nas/ sa ma ya ho: bar dang*/ bshags skong gi rang gi thugs ka= sogs nas/ snyen pa ci 'grub/ hūm̐ hrī: mchod yon brgyad dang= sogs/ hūm̐ hrī: padma 'od 'bar= sogs/ bshags skong*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar= sogs nas/ a ā: bar dang*/ dkon spyi tshogs/ hrī: bdag nyid lha yi= sogs nas/ pū dza khā hi: bar dang*/ hūm̐: stong gsum= sogs nas/ thams cad dang= bar dang*/ ho:tshogs kyi mchod pa= sogs nas/ ba ling ta khā hi: bar dang*/ hūm̐: dngos po= sogs nas/ sa ma ya a ā: yan tshar lnga/ gong ltar rig me dor/ gnang ba nod/ gnas 'dren dbu nas/ zhing khams de rnams su dbang bsgyur te bsod nams gyi don thogs pa med pa 'byung bar gyur cig: bar dang*/ gong ga ི tshe 'das kyi spyi bor rgyal ba= sogs nas tshar lnga'i mthar 'phro thud nas/ lam bstan yan/ phyi dro las byang tshogs skong tshar bzhi/ gnas 'dren tshar bzhi mthar me sbar bcas/ bzang spyod sogs bsngo smon rgyas par gtang*/

dkar gtor/ 318) rtsa rgyud/ zhi khro'i skul pa/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub= sogs nas/ hūm̐ phaṭa: spyi 'dus chad tho/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang= sogs nas/ bzlog tu gsol: bar dang*/ bshags skong*/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig= sogs nas/ mā ra ya phaṭa: bar dang*/ spyi 'dus brtan ma/ khyad par= nas/ siddhi hūm̐: bar dang*/ zhi khro'i/ hūm̐: ye nas= sogs nas/ siddhi hūm̐: bar dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su= yig brgya gsum/ 'dir ni rten dang= zhi khro'i smon lam/ ho: bdag gzhan dge ba= sogs nas/ lhun 'grub shog oṃ āḥhūm̐: skyabs med= sogs nas/ chen por shog: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= sogs bya'o/ /nyin chog rkyang pa ni kar gling zhi khro nyid btang na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu go zhes pa'ang tshe dbang gi bzhed pa skong phyir g.yar khral tsam du padma nor bus bris pa dge legs 'phel//
